summary: Test suite covers core matrix generation logic (cartesian product, include/exclude, validation) but critically fails to meet explicit task requirements. Missing: (1) act integration tests—task mandates 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' and requires act-result.txt artifact, but no test invokes act or captures output; (2) GitHub Actions workflow file (.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml) and test fixtures (fixtures/sample-config.json) referenced by workflow-structure tests are not provided; (3) CLI integration tests (stdin/file I/O, JSON parse errors); (4) MatrixValue type variety (numbers, booleans tested only as strings); (5) 3D+ dimensional matrices; (6) complex include patterns. Workflow test couples to disk existence without setup. Core unit tests are cleanly organized but insufficient to satisfy the requirement that testing must happen exclusively through GitHub Actions via act.
